ways.label: Kapowairua (Spirits Bay) to Te Paki Stream
ways.time: 4-5 days, see individual track descriptions for times
evidence: The track follows the coastline from Kapowairua (Spirits Bay) on the North-eastern Coast, past Cape Reinga/Te Rerenga Wairua (where the Te Araroa Trail starts) and finishes at Te Paki Stream on the West Coast.

access_points.name: Tapotupotu
access_points.quote: Tapotupotu – turn off SH1 2 km south of Te Rerenga Wairua

access_points.name: Cape Reinga/Te Rerenga Wairua
access_points.quote: Cape Reinga/Te Rerenga Wairua – follow SH1 north

exits.name: Pandora Track towards SH1
exits.quote: head towards SH1 via the Pandora Track
exits.from: junction between Pandora and Tapotupotu Bay

exits.name: road to Waitiki from Te Paki Stream parking area
exits.quote: It is approximately 9 km to Waitiki via the road from here.

side_trips.name: Cape Maria Van Diemen
side_trips.quote: a side trip to Cape Maria Van Diemen

doubts: Four campsites are mentioned but not named, so no huts. Te Paki Stream end (parking area) has no matching entry. Quotes for access points are as in the text (Tapotupotu quote uses an en dash). Via order follows section headings. Cape Reinga ref T4 (coast) chosen over T3 (place). Section 'Cape Reinga to Te Werahi Beach Track' is 2 km return, treated as part of the way.
